title: bbnomodpack
description: The official modpack for the (almost but not)-official bbno$ server.
body:
Does what it says on the tin. It's the modpack for the fan-operated server affiliated with the official bbno$ Discord ([baby no server](https://discord.gg/w24SKcnnbx)), sponsored by [BAKKBONE Australia](https://www.bakkbone.com.au/). Hop in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/w24SKcnnbx) for server access.

This pack is fairly light-weight and features some very basic QoL features including (but not limited to):
- AuthMe (for relogging without needing to restart the game)
- DiscordRPC (to show off that you're playing THE bbnomodpack to your friends on discord)
- Xaero's mini/worldmap
- Simple voicechat (so we can hear your lovely(?) voice)
- Iris (for shaders)

+ a copy of Photon shaders to get you started there.

This modpack's QoL offerings may change in the future based on demand, as such, if it does ever change we have also included a modpack update checker to notify you when a newer version is available!
